policies.detection_mechanism: Readiness Probe Active Ping Timeout (>500ms) or Connection Refused
policies.automated_response: Withdraw instance from load balancer routing pool; start exponential reconnect
policies.recovery_action: Reconnect with jitter (max 5 attempts); re-enable traffic once probe returns 200

policies.failure_type: Important Dependency Degradation (Redis Cache / AI Secondary)
policies.detection_mechanism: Latency Spike (>2000ms) or Circuit Breaker Open
policies.automated_response: Engage fallback bypass mode (direct DB / cached fallback); trigger P3 warning alert
policies.recovery_action: Periodically test circuit half-open probe; restore primary cache routing on success

policies.automated_response: Fail-open: buffer telemetry in memory ring-buffer or drop gracefully without erroring
policies.recovery_action: Background worker retries exporter socket connection silently

policies.detection_mechanism: Liveness Probe Heartbeat Timeout (>5000ms) or Out-of-Memory signal
policies.automated_response: Kubernetes kubelet / Docker daemon terminates container and spawns fresh instance
policies.recovery_action: Orchestrator restarts pod; post-restart startup probe confirms initialization

policies.detection_mechanism: Request Queue Depth > Threshold or High CPU Load Alert
policies.automated_response: Trigger Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA); shed non-critical background workloads
policies.recovery_action: Scale replica set up; resume standard processing once load normalizes
